value.rationale: Natural exact classification at two reusable variables for the standard Ferrers graph class, with a sharp qualitative contrast between the complete inability of counting-free FO² to see nonstar structure and complete identification by C². The proof gives an intrinsic stable equitable-cell reconstruction dichotomy applicable to canonical colored-quotient methods, not a mere parameter substitution. Relative scope explicitly avoids the stronger false claim of absolute C² identification.
